summary: MV-2015-240 distinguishes the wider {{PRJ0057:n_compounds}}-article AT15 set from the six displayed rat Oral/IV PK profiles. The project interpretation of acceptable systemic clearance but limited oral exposure applies to the displayed PK subset, with variability between compounds. Aldrevessa revisited the dosing vehicle; this workbook does not claim the wider set was dosed or had acceptable clearance.
